description.en: Recognition and management of intra- and post-procedural bleeding and perforation during ESD: haemostatic techniques for active bleeding, closure techniques for perforation (clips, OTSCs, endoscopic suturing, stent placement for oesophageal perforation).

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for esd adverse-event management but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs esd adverse-event management independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches esd adverse-event management to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
